note_title: 模1均匀分布序列对序列差分的要求

callouts.id: 模1均匀分布序列对序列差分的要求#1
callouts.title: 命题1：模1均匀分布的一个必要条件
callouts.body: 如果序列$x_n$是模1均匀分布的，那么序列的差分$\Delta x_n$需要满足条件$$\limsup_{n\to \infty} n|\Delta x_n|=+\infty$$

classification_result.id: 模1均匀分布序列对序列差分的要求#1
classification_result.english_title: Proposition 1: A Necessary Condition for Uniform Distribution Modulo 1

if_problem.statement_en:
If the sequence $x_n$ is uniformly distributed modulo $1$, then its difference sequence $\Delta x_n$ must satisfy
$$\limsup_{n\to \infty} n|\Delta x_n|=+\infty.$$

callouts.id: 模1均匀分布序列对序列差分的要求#2
callouts.title: Littlewood_Tauber定理(1911)
callouts.body: 如果序列$y_n$是Abel可和的，且Abel和收敛到$a$，即$$\lim_{x\to 1^{-}}\sum_{n\geq 0}y_nx^n=a$$并且$y_n = O\left(\frac{1}{n}\right)$那么该序列的和收敛到$a$:$$\sum_{n\geq 0}y_n = a$$

classification_result.id: 模1均匀分布序列对序列差分的要求#2

if_problem.statement_en:
If the sequence $y_n$ is Abel summable and its Abel sum converges to $a$, that is,
$$\lim_{x\to 1^{-}}\sum_{n\geq 0}y_nx^n=a,$$
and moreover $y_n = O\left(\frac{1}{n}\right)$, then the series itself converges to $a$:
$$\sum_{n\geq 0}y_n = a.$$

callouts.id: 模1均匀分布序列对序列差分的要求#3
callouts.title: Littlewood_Tauber定理的推论
callouts.body: 如果一个序列$y_n$的算术平均值收敛到$a$,并且其差分具有估计$\Delta y_n = O\left(\frac{1}{n}\right)$那么$y_n$的极限存在且为$a$。

classification_result.id: 模1均匀分布序列对序列差分的要求#3

if_problem.statement_en:
If the arithmetic means of a sequence $y_n$ converge to $a$, and its differences satisfy the estimate
$$\Delta y_n = O\left(\frac{1}{n}\right),$$
then the limit of $y_n$ exists and is equal to $a$.
